entities.name: Replay protection
entities.description: Mechanism to ensure that the same NAS message is not accepted twice by the receiver. For a given EPS security context, a given NAS COUNT value shall be accepted at most one time and only if message integrity verifies correctly.

entities.name: NAS message
entities.description: Non-Access Stratum message exchanged between UE and MME.

entities.name: EPS security context
entities.description: Security context used in EPS for integrity protection and ciphering.

entities.name: NAS COUNT
entities.description: Counter value used for replay protection and integrity protection of NAS messages.

entities.name: EIA0
entities.description: Null integrity protection algorithm where no integrity protection is applied.

relations.description: Replay protection applies to received NAS messages in both MME and UE.
Replay protection is applied per EPS security context.
Replay protection ensures each NAS COUNT value is accepted at most once per security context.
Replay protection is not applicable when EIA0 is used.
